closing.summary: Big strengths are carb quality, works across a lot of cooking styles, and quite filling, but the biggest weaknesses are low protein amount, low iron, and low vitamin A. It is good for practical meals, low-calorie volume, and immune support because the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around, it can add bulk or fullness without much calorie pressure, and vitamin C gives the immune-support side a reason to exist.
